items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I think Mel Lewis and Britt Woodman were on that band that night

ctx.x: I’m not getting it. But I’m sorry it didn’t work out because I felt like I would have been a good bass player for him. It would have been a good situation for me. I thought I could have done the job. I knew the music and I’m sure I would have learned a whole lot. I think Mel Lewis and Britt Woodman were on that band that night and I’ve forgotten, some other really fine people. And I would have loved to have stuck around for a while. First of all I could have made a lot of money, because he was still working…
I think he probably got a few other people’s too.
